scope: Revisit the original 129 anchors x 40 steps x 2 policies for all eleven fixed Pils/Lager source profiles without the obsolete standardized-response filter. Keep empirical target ranges, two style classifiers, chemical caps, target-distance improvement, all five raw integer-grade guards and all 30 calibrated/uncalibrated raw probability guards. No new anchors, fractions, concentration threshold, slack, random-seed search or relaxed defect condition.
control: All 8293 historically eligible candidate IDs must be reconstructed with the same coordinates, distances, raw guard deltas and pass flags within 1e-10. Any control mismatch stops publication.
selection: Minimum frozen 0.7 target distance + 0.3 change distance among complete model-scenario passes. A passing result is supplementary and does not automatically replace the task6 main result, establish stable refit behavior or physical feasibility. Empty sets remain empty.
